name: Test Island (1024, thin beaches)
description: Single-island preset for tools/scripts/mapgen/test-island-roundtrip.bat. Inherits defaults from test-no-poi but trims the sand frontier and dug-shore band so the larger 1024x1024 canvas devotes more area to interior biomes (snow, jungle, desert, swamp) instead of coast. Pair with test-paint-island.ps1 -Size 1024.
